{{Quote|A warrior never regrets death. Only dishonor.|Praven|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
'''Praven''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and later protected the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Sith training|Trained]] as a [[Sith Warrior]] by [[Darth Angral]], Praven participated in the [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]]. In the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Praven took on Angral's son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] as his own [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and trained the [[Human/Legends|Human]] as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], but Praven's training was not enough to prevent Tarnis's [[Death/Legends|death]] [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|at the hands]] of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] when Tarnis [[Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)|attempted]] to unleash the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against Coruscant near the end of the Cold War. Angral's pursuit of revenge drove him to [[Desolator crisis|dispatch]] his apprentices across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in order to steal other Republic weapon projects, and Praven acquired the [[Shock Drum]] weapon on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after defeating the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]].

However, Praven's sense of honor caused him to disobey his Master and challenge the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to a [[Duel on the Esus Mesa|duel]] instead of destroying Tatooine with the Shock Drum, and the Knight was able to convince the Sith Lord to abandon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Finding a new purpose as a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Praven learned the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] and gladly joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in defending the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] when the [[Galactic War]] broke out with the Empire. Under the leadership of the instrument of his redemption, the Jedi Knight now known as the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Praven and the rest of the Jedi reinforcements foiled the plans of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and prevented the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Braga]] from killing thousands of civilians.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Now I understand why Tarnis was no match for you. His death was my failure. I should've trained him better.|Praven, on his teaching of Tarnis|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Praven was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into a family that took pride in the purity of its heritage.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> He was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] early in his youth and underwent [[Sith training|training]] in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] while also becoming adamantly loyal to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and its [[Tenebrae|Emperor]]. A true believer in [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] philosophy who developed his own code of personal honor, Praven also developed an intense hatred of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lord Praven}}</ref> and the [[Sith Warrior]] was taken on by the powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> sometime before the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Codex" /> Under Angral's tutelage, Praven achieved the rank of Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] himself and in turn took on Angral's own son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], as his apprentice; Praven's student soon became a Sith Lord in his own right.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Praven was among the Sith who participated in a bold [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the fighting, Praven engaged the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Usma]], one of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] most celebrated [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber duelists]], in combat, and their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] ended when the Sith Lord [[Death/Legends|killed]] Usma. However, Praven spared [[Usma's Padawan]] before telling her to seek him out once the Jedi had completed her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] so that the two could face each other as equals.<ref name="Codex" /> Praven also killed a [[Fir Megsan's father|Republic soldier]] whose son, [[Fir Megsan]], would later set a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Sith's head in an attempt to gain revenge.<ref name="Lord Praven">{{TORcite|type=message|Lord Praven|Fir Megsan}}</ref> In the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] that followed the Sacking of Coruscant, as the battle came to be known, the Republic was forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which ended the Great Galactic War and called for the immediate withdraw of Republic forces from battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Timeline 1" />

Robbed of his chance to destroy the Republic, Angral spent the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] weaving complex plots to bring about his enemy's destruction<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>&mdash;one of which sent Tarnis on an undercover mission as [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Eli Tarnis, a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] in the [[Republic superweapon initiative]]. Praven's former student quickly became the head of the [[Planet Prison]] project, while Angral took on two more apprentices, [[Sadic]] and [[Nefarid]].<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> Praven gained a reputation among the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] after an encounter with an [[Unidentified Imperial major|Imperial major]] ended with the man's death: Praven was insulted by the lack of respect that the [[Major/Legends|major]] chose to show him and [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], demanding an apology before breaking the man's neck as punishment.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Sometime during the Cold War, Usma's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] tracked down Praven as he had told her to, and the Sith Lord obliged her by sending the woman to the same fate as her Master.<ref name="Codex" /> During his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a Sith, Praven encountered the [[Immortality/Legends|immortal]] Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the [[Emperor's Wrath]], who served as the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] personal executioner.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

===Angral's crusade===
{{Quote|Greetings, Jedi. I am Lord Praven. My master seeks retribution for his son's death. I must give it to him.|Praven introduces himself to the Knight|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
[[File:Angral_and_Praven.png|thumb|left|210px|Angral and Praven]]
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Tarnis seized control of the Planet Prison project and set it up in the ruins of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, intending to use it against the Republic capital while he made his escape. Praven was with Angral, Sadic, and Nefarid at a [[Imperial Listening Post|secret Imperial facility]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] when Tarnis contacted his [[Parent/Legends|father]] and relayed via [[holograph]]ic transmission the success of his plans to evade his Jedi and Republic pursuers. Praven's former apprentice also sent his father copies of files on all of the Republic's [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] projects, but the conversation was interrupted by the arrival of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the Padawan [[Kira Carsen]]. Sadic mockingly reprimanded Tarnis for failing to tie up loose ends, but Angral urged his son to strike down his enemies, and Praven watched with the others as Tarnis engaged the two Jedi in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]]&mdash;a battle that ended in Tarnis's death. A furious Angral declared undying hatred for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] on account of that, and Praven promised his Master that he would personally kill the Jedi.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Tarnis's death drove Angral to the edge of sanity, and in his rage the Sith Lord dispatched his three apprentices to take control of the three superweapons that were detailed in Tarnis's files.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> While Sadic and Nefarid were sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="The Power Guard Project">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Power Guard Project|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> and the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], respectively,<ref name="The Death Mark">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Death Mark|Alderaan}}</ref> Praven traveled to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he commanded a detachment of Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in his search for the [[Shock Drum]]&mdash;a weapon that utilized seismic vibrations as an offensive weapon, literally softening up enemy defenses, though the device would destabilize the core of a planet after enough time. Storming the [[Shock Drum facility|Shock Drum Facility]] in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]] and destroying the compound's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], Praven discovered the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] was there to defend the project, and the Sith Lord defeated the Jedi in battle despite losing many of his soldiers. However, Praven's sense of honor led him to take Kiwiiks alive as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], and he destroyed the project's [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] and took the Shock Drum prototype. Informing the project staff that they were no threat and therefore did not deserve an unjust death, Praven departed the facility with his two prizes and the remaining soldiers.<ref name="The Shock Drum">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Shock Drum|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:Praven_holo.png|thumb|right|160px|Praven contacts the Knight.]]
While traveling west into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region, Praven contacted Angral and relayed his success. Angral ordered his apprentice to activate the Shock Drum weapon and leave Kiwiiks to die alongside it, ensuring that the Jedi Master would suffer before her death, and he also commanded Praven to destroy the Shock Drum's deactivation codes so that Tarnis's killer would be unable to prevent the Shock Drum from destroying Tatooine. However, Praven was disgusted by his Master's attempts at treachery, and his honor drove him to disobey that final order after leaving the active Shock Drum and Kiwiiks beneath an [[Dune Sea mining complex|abandoned mining complex]] in the Dune Sea.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> Praven contacted the recently arrived Jedi Knight, who had just finished restoring the research facility's scanners in order to locate the weapon, and interrupted the Knight's [[Hologram/Legends|holocall]] to the researcher [[Hare'en]]. Informing the Jedi that he had changed the Shock Drum's deactivation codes so that only he possessed them, Praven challenged the Knight to an honorable duel in the mountains in exchange for the codes.<ref name="Race Against Doom">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race Against Doom|Tatooine}}</ref>

===Confrontation and redemption===
{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|There is nothing more to say. You won our duel. Finish me.''"<br />"''Jedi are taught to see all possibilities. I see one where you live on with honor. Commit yourself to the path of light. Become a Jedi.''"<br />"''You could kill me, but refuse. Not out of fear&hellip; but compassion.|Praven and the Knight|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
[[File:Praven_defeated.png|thumb|left|190px|A defeated Praven kneels after the duel.]]
Praven sent the Jedi the coordinates for the [[Esus Mesa]] and awaited his opponent there. He was at the far edge of the mesa, gazing out across the Dune Sea, when he sensed the Knight's powerful presence in the Force approaching. Praven understood that his student had died because the Knight was more powerful than Tarnis had been, and that realization filled the Sith with a sense of regret that the Jedi was surprised to feel. When questioned by the Jedi, Praven stated that he relied on the passions of integrity and honor rather than the lesser emotions of arrogance, hatred, and fear, and he drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to begin their duel. The Knight and a companion battled Praven back and forth across the mesa, with Praven utilizing tactics such as physical combat, Force blasts, [[Force Stasis/Legends|Force paralysis]], and Force barriers in his struggle against the pair. However, the duel ultimately ended in Praven's defeat, and the wounded Sith Lord fell to his knees in submission.<ref name="Desert Duel" />

Yet to Praven's surprise, the Knight did not move immediately to kill the Sith Lord, and he questioned the Jedi as to why. Praven brushed aside the Knight's attempts to convince him to abandon the dark side, acknowledging that the Jedi would be a powerful Sith, but he admired his opponent's resolve and fulfilled his part of their bargain by giving the Jedi the deactivation codes. Praven further informed the Knight of Kiwiiks' situation, explaining that she was specifically targeted by Angral because she detected Tarnis's presence on Coruscant, and then asked the Knight to end their duel with his death. However, the Jedi refused and again asked Praven to forsake the dark side, finally convincing him to do so by sparing his life.<ref name="Desert Duel" />

Accepting the Knight's offer, Praven urged the Jedi to go and save Tatooine while he departed the Esus Mesa and contacted the nearest Republic [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].<ref name="Desert Duel" /> Praven surrendered himself to Republic authorities with the request that he speak with the Jedi Order, and to his surprise the Order accepted him into their ranks as a Padawan. Under the tutelage of the Jedi, Praven forsook his past as a Sith and devoted himself to becoming a servant of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. Praven later sent a message to the Knight, who succeeded in shutting down the Shock Drum, expressing his thanks and informing the Jedi that he intended to devote himself to making up for his past actions as a Sith.<ref name="A New Path">{{TORcite|type=message|A New Path|Lord Praven}}</ref>

===Battle for Corellia===
{{Quote|You've come a long way since the last time I saw you, Lord Praven.''"<br />"''Just Praven. That title doesn't hold meaning for me, anymore.|The Hero and Praven|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
Eventually, the Cold War escalated into a full-fledged [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Empire.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Praven was sent to the embattled planet of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he [[Ground warfare/Legends|fought]] alongside the native [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Having shed his title of Lord, Praven worked to defend the citizens of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] from the battle, and when the Padawan learned that the Empire had dispatched several [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] to destroy a resistance cell in the tunnels beneath the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] region, he immediately set out to save the resistance fighters. Utilizing his personal [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed lightsaber, Praven defended the fighters as waves of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] attacked, and during the battle Praven was joined by the same Knight whom he had fought on Tatooine&mdash;a Knight who had become known as the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] after [[Battle of the Oppressor|defeating]] Darth Angral two years earlier. When the Knight and a companion found Praven, the former Sith drew his lightsaber and sent it spiraling past the new arrivals to destroy the trio of war droids that were approaching from behind the Jedi. Praven then greeted the Hero, explaining that he never received the chance to thank the Knight for changing his life. Upon learning that the Hero had been appointed [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Supreme Commander]] of all Jedi on Corellia, Praven complied with the Knight's instructions to rendezvous with the other Jedi at the [[Socorro Freight building]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

[[File:Praven_on_Corellia.png|thumb|right|170px|Praven on Corellia]]
At the freight building, Praven assumed a leadership role within the newly gathered Jedi reinforcements for the Hero in the [[Battle of Corellia|mission]] to stop the corrupted Jedi [[Tol Braga]]. Braga was attempting to massacre thousands of civilians so that the Sith Emperor could begin a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark ritual]] and thereby consume all life in the galaxy. Under the command of the Hero's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Unaw Aharo]], Praven and the other Jedi followed the Hero's orders to relocate to the [[Labor Valley]] district,<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> and he worked alongside his fellow Jedi to liberate the weapons factories of Republic-allied corporate official [[Magremme Thrakus]]. By doing so, the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] Jedi reclaimed a valuable source of munitions for the Republic Military effort while the Hero of Tython prevented several Sith from detonating a chemical bomb in the area.<ref name="Death Cloud">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Death Cloud|Corellia}}</ref>

Praven, Aharo, and the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Jedi [[Bengel Morr]] then led the Jedi to the [[Axial Park]] district, and the trio met with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brint]] of the Republic Military and Corellia's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jol Zackin]] in the [[Corellian Science Museum]]. The senator asked the Jedi to rescue a large number of wrongfully [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] civilians from the Empire's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps in the area, and Zackin was engaged in a fierce argument with Brint when the Hero arrived, and Praven listened as both Brint and Zackin made their cases to the Knight. The Knight ignored Brint's attempts to bribe the Jedi with advanced combat equipment, choosing to commit the Jedi to Zackin's cause instead of that of Brint, as the colonel wanted the Jedi to strike back against the Empire in revenge for Imperial raids on the Republic's medical evacuation sites. Morr, Praven, and Aharo then complied with the Hero's orders, leading their fellow Jedi in raids against the nearby slave camps,<ref name="Firestorm">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Firestorm|Corellia}}</ref> and traveled to the [[Drall Library]] in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] to meet up with their [[Commander/Legends|commander]] after completing their mission.<ref name="Mutual">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Mutual Assured Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>

While the Hero infiltrated the Imperial [[Cruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]] [[Eclipse (Harrower-class)|''Eclipse'']] above the city and prevented Tol Braga from detonating the ship's [[Engine/Legends|engines]], Praven and the other Jedi worked with the forces of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] to distract the Empire's forces by raiding Imperial strongholds across the district. After the fighting, the Hero assigned the Jedi to work with Suthra while the Knight departed for a [[Dromund Kaas operation|final confrontation]] with the Emperor, and Praven continued to fight alongside the Republic<ref name="Mutual" /> as they achieved victory in the Battle of Corellia.<ref name="Fall of Corellia">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Fall of Corellia|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My master deserves justice, but there are more noble ways to have it. I will destroy you personally.|Praven|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
[[File:Praven_ready.png|thumb|left|200px|Lord Praven]]
Praven had red skin and fleshy tendrils in place of eyebrows above his red-orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which were common to his species. The bridge of his [[Nose/Legends|nose]] featured several natural ridges, and he typically wore a bodysuit that also covered all of his head except for his face. The suit was gray and blue-green in color, and also had headset-like attachments on either side of his head. He wore dark grey [[Sith apparel|robes]] over his lower body, as well as a small [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] with two antennas and a silver equipment belt. The single most important principle of a warrior, in Praven's mind, was a strong sense of honor.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> Fiercely loyal to the Empire and an ardent believer in the strength and power of the dark side during his time as a Sith, Praven was unlike many of his fellow Sith in that he was calm and collected in his speech and actions. He followed a strict code of personal honor, eschewing the random acts of sadism and cruelty that his fellows often partook in. Despite his sense of honor, however, Praven was raised to believe that the Jedi still sought vengeance against the Sith for the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], and he considered members of the Order to be his personal enemies.<ref name="Codex" /> Praven's pride in his heritage was so strong that he killed an Imperial officer for not showing him the proper respect that he felt was due to a pureblooded Sith.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

However, Praven grew disillusioned with Sith philosophy while witnessing Darth Angral's descent into madness. Praven's sense of duty led him to carry out Angral's orders, but the elder Sith's drive for revenge and his callous disregard for both honor and the lives of innocents clashed greatly with Praven's personal values, which ultimately drove him to defy Angral by challenging the Jedi Knight to a duel. Praven ignored the Knight's initial attempts to convert him to the Jedi way, but the Knight's refusal to kill him was the catalyst that opened Praven to the possibility. As a result, Praven was able to renounce his past as a Sith without forsaking his honor and personal values, and found that the path of a Jedi Padawan came easily when he accepted his place among the Jedi. Despite the strange contrast between saving lives and taking them, Praven felt more righteous and secure in his actions as a Jedi than he had ever felt as a Sith.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|It's a strange thing, saving lives instead of taking them. But it feels right. I'm stronger than I've ever been.|Praven|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
As a Sith, Praven was very strong in the dark side of the Force, though he felt stronger with the light side as a Jedi.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> He wielded a single red-bladed lightsaber as both a Sith and a Jedi, and he was skilled in the use of a wide variety of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], including [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], Force blasts, and Force paralysis. He was also a skilled [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed]] combatant, making use of physical blows in conjunction with lightsaber combat to overpower his opponents,<ref name="Desert Duel" /> and was capable of guiding a thrown lightsaber with enough accuracy to destroy three war droids with one throw.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Wait&hellip; wait&hellip; what have you done? I approached you with honor, and you tricked me! How dare you?|Praven, after being mind-tricked|<ref name="Desert Duel" />}}
Praven was created for the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which he is a recurring character in the Jedi Knight-class storyline.<ref name="Desert Duel" /> The character's first appearance is in hologram form in the mission "Race to the Ruins" on Coruscant.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> Praven is not encountered again until the planet Tatooine, where he challenges the player to a duel for the deactivation codes for the Shock Drum in the mission "Desert Duel." At the end of the duel, the player has three choices: convince Praven to become a Jedi, allow him to leave, or kill him. The player can also Force persuade Praven into giving the codes before their battle begins, angering Praven. However, he can still be redeemed afterward. If Praven is killed, the player will receive dark side alignment points,<ref name="Desert Duel" /> and the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] Jedi [[Goril Sevintran]] will appear in Praven's place on Corellia in the Act III mission "Jedi Commander."<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> Praven was also mentioned in the reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which was released in [[2012]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
